source_views.translation_trust_boundary: The complete kernel uses the existing admitted shared DSL and normalized full-source projection. The original wrapper is modeled separately by ordered logical tensor metadata and was source-compared/probed, not admitted as Python by the shared DSL. The grid executes every actual program with previous memory; reference has independent prior-reference-memory recurrence. Native ABI, caller dtype domain, launch legality and concurrency remain separate.

declarations.dtype_profile: All six source-asserted input/weight profiles and explicit fp16/bf16/fp32 output binding; unrestricted natural logical shape/stride metadata, all ordered host branches including 3D/singleton-4D, source-derived BLOCK_K/EVEN_K/CAST_TYPE, both ADD_INPUTS values, all (N,batches) programs in one sequential schedule, mathematical signed indices.

original_scope.covered: Complete ordered logical wrapper and successful actual sequential execution of every grid program, or ordered host rejection before launch. The final independent memory and global frame retain inter-program aliases and changed indices.
remaining_structural_obligations: Unrestricted output/index dtype domain is not closed: output is explicitly bound to fp16/bf16/fp32, and indices use the inherited mathematical signed-cell model. The original Python wrapper has no output/index dtype assertion.

Logical natural tensor metadata, contiguous checks, squeeze and region data pointers need native tensor/byte-memory/allocation correspondence. Source Python-to-logical-model equivalence is reviewed/probed, not a verified Python compiler theorem.

Fixed-width integer arithmetic, intermediate overflow, negative active indices, native pointer/address legality and allocated bounds remain open. The total interpreter uses Nat/Int element offsets and may clamp negative pointer offsets.

Native block/arange/resource legality and JIT/launch admission remain open, including zero-N SPLIT_N=0 and empty grids. The installed six-shift next_power_of_2 is modeled exactly, without asserting an ideal unbounded power-of-two property.
One explicit pid0-fastest sequential traversal is proved. Native GPU cross-program scheduling, read/write races, byte aliases and schedule independence remain unproved.
remaining_native_numerical_bindings: Bind native FP configuration, rounding/FTZ/special values and low-precision operations to the software operations.
Bind compiled reduction tree, seeds, fusion and reassociation to the supplied valid ReductionPlan.
Bind native conversion details, including fp16/bf16 cross-conversion via fp32 and NaN/signed-zero behavior.
